adClickIdField.statement: This page has NO hidden "Ad Click ID" field. This is an explicit negative finding, not an omission. Verified four independent ways: (1) the strings "Ad Click", "ad_click", "adclick", "gclid", "fbclid" and "wbraid" appear ZERO times anywhere in the served HTML (1,295,862 bytes / 1,295,779 UTF-8 characters); (2) the DOM contains exactly four <input> elements (first_name, last_name, phone, email) and zero inputs of type="hidden"; (3) the string type="hidden" appears zero times in the document; (4) the GHL form definition in the __NUXT_DATA__ payload lists exactly five entries in its fields array — first_name, last_name, phone, email, and the submit button — with no hidden field of any kind. Nothing on the page captures a click ID, so no click ID reaches the GHL contact record from this form.
